spans.s:
(इ) रघि r. 1st cl. (रंघते)
To go, to move.
r. 10th cl. (रंघयति)
To shine;
also without the indicatory letter, r. 10th cl. (राघयति)
To taste.

(ऋ,) राघृ r. 1st cl. (राघते)
To be able or equal to.

m. (-घुः)
1 The name of a sovereign of Oude, the great grandfather of

The family or descendants of RAGHU.
E.
लघि to shine, कु Uṇādi aff., ल changed to र, and the nasal augment rejected.

m. (-रः)
The poet KĀLIDĀSA.
E.
रघु the race of RAGHU, which forms the subject of a poem by this writer, and कार author.

m. (-नः)
RĀMA, the second incarnation of VIṢṆU, under that appellation.
E.
रघु the king RAGHU, and नन्दन a son or descendant.

m. (-थः)
A name of RĀMA.
E.
रघु the race of RAGHU, and नाथ lord, chief.

m. (-शः)
The race or family of RAGHU; hence also the name of a poem by KĀLIDĀSA, which treats of the ancestors of RĀMA, from DILĪPA to that prince, and his descendants to AGNIVARṆA; nearly one half relates to the history of RAGHU and as much to that of RĀMA, the remainder is occupied with the remaining princes.
E.
रघु as above, and वंश race.

m. (-रः)
RĀMA.
E.
रघु the race of RAGHU, and वर eminent.

m. (-हः)
RĀMA.
E.
रघु the race of RAGHU, and उद्वह pre-eminent.

A sort of fish.
E.
रघु the ancestor of the demigod, and अण् aff. of descent.
